## MKCinema 1.3: the Windows app opens reliably

| Platform | File | Requirements |
|---|---|---|
| Windows | `MKCinema.exe` (app 1.1.0) | Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit, Microsoft Edge WebView2 |
| Android TV, Google TV, Fire TV | `MKCinema-TV.apk` | Android TV 7 or later |
| Android phones and tablets | `MKCinema.apk` (the same file) | Android 7 or later |
| LG webOS (beta) | `com.mkcinema.app_1.1.0_all.ipk` | unchanged |
| macOS, Linux | unchanged from 1.0 | |

- **Windows: fixes the app closing right after it opens.** If Microsoft Edge WebView2 failed to start, the app crashed without a message. It now tells you what went wrong, offers Microsoft's WebView2 download when that's the fix, and writes details to `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MKCinema\mkcinema.log`.
- **Windows:** one window only, a window sized to your screen that remembers where you left it, true fullscreen for video (and F11), outside links open in your browser, and the page recovers by itself if it crashes.

The exe isn't code-signed yet, so the first run shows "Windows protected your PC": choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

If the app still closes, please open an issue and attach `mkcinema.log` from `%LOCALAPPDATA%\MKCinema`.
